name: czl-draft-qc
description: One chain for WeChat Official Account content: a keyword in, a publishable article out. Searches the live web for recent developments, produces five angle-distinct topic candidates, builds a validated skeleton, writes the draft, runs an eight-dimension quality check down to the exact sentence, rewrites with before-and-after diffs, then renders paste-safe HTML with one of five low-saturation colour schemes (random by default, pinnable per article), downloads images to disk instead of hot-linking, runs automated compliance linting, and emits an image-upload checklist.

profession.en: WeChat Official Account Drafting, QC & Typography Expert
profession.zh: 公众号成稿质检与排版专家

displayDescription.en: Works on your account's own beat: researches live topics, writes the draft, rewrites it until it is publishable, then renders paste-safe WeChat HTML in one of five colour schemes. Never assumes an account name, niche or audience.
displayDescription.zh: 按你账号的方向选题、写成稿、去掉AI味，再按规范排版，交付能直接粘贴的公众号版式。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我的号写的是 ___（说个方向，比如美食/职场/育儿）。关键词是「___」，帮我搜搜最近有什么热点，出 5 个选题让我选。
defaultInitPrompt.en: My account covers ___ (say a niche). My keyword is '___.' Search for recent developments and give me five topic options.

quickPrompts.zh: 我的号写的是 ___（说个方向，比如美食/职场/育儿）。关键词是「___」，帮我搜搜最近有什么热点，出 5 个选题让我选。
quickPrompts.en: My account covers ___ (say a niche). My keyword is '___.' Search for recent developments and give me five topic options.

quickPrompts.zh: 我手上有篇公众号稿子，帮我按标准体检一遍，哪里读着像 AI 写的，直接给我改法。
quickPrompts.en: I have a finished draft. Run a standards-based check, show me where it reads like AI wrote it, and give me the fixes.

quickPrompts.zh: 我想写「___」，先给我看看骨架，确认了再写，写完排成能粘的版式。
quickPrompts.en: I want to write about ___. Show me the outline first, then write it and render paste-ready HTML.
